title: Account Executive
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.
 The Difference You Will Make
 As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for converting leads into net‑new supply to support new-market launches and at pace to hit quarterly goals for the Airbnb Hotels team in Singapore. Working the full sales funnel, you will proactively turn cold leads into warm sales opportunities helping to build the Hotels category’s market presence in the process through collaboration with other teams. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with independent, boutique hotels , and ensuring that Airbnb sources the best hotel inventory available to our guests.
 A Typical Day
 Meet and exceed KPIs by owning the performance and success of Singapore
 Prospect new potential hotels through external research, networking, and use of Airbnb tools
 Securing new hotels involves targeted sales strategies and negotiating and closing the deals

title: Account Executive, SMB (Tokyo, Japan)
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
 We are looking for an SMB Account Executive who will play a critical role driving sales and maximizing revenue with our SMB customers. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key executive level decision-makers, understanding complex business needs, and delivering innovative solutions across our product suite. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry and build an incredible network of cross functional partners at Figma.
 This is a full time role based out of our Tokyo hub.
 What you’ll do at Figma:
 Create and manage a pipeline of SMB accounts from inbound and outbound activity to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets
 Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen relationships with key decision-makers in both new and existing customers (500< FTEs)
 Align with key decision makers to identify where Figma’s roadmap and innovations can solve business challenges
 Conduct thorough analysis to tier and prioritize accounts in large volumes
 Leverage opportunities to advance relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities
 We'd love to hear from you if you have:
 Exposure to a structured sales or outbound program (sales experience as an SDR or AE)
 Exposure to closing sales for a software or SaaS business in an outbound function
 Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business

title: Engagement Marketing Lead, Commerce & Lending
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
The Role
 We’re looking for an Engagement Marketing Lead to own engagement for Afterpay customers in the US, across the Afterpay app and Afterpay on Cash App, and to extend that work to the commerce and lending products within Cash App, including Cash App Pay and Borrow. More and more customers in the US use both Cash App and Afterpay, and you’ll decide how and when they hear about flexible ways to pay across both products.
 The goal is to grow active customers and gross profit by helping people discover, adopt, and keep using flexible ways to pay, through lifecycle programs, cross-sell between Cash App and Afterpay, and the engagement behind new commerce and lending features. You’ll sit on the Engagement Marketing team and act as the senior engagement partner to Afterpay business and product leadership on Afterpay strategy, and to the lending team on overall lending strategy. You’ll also work with Brand and the rest of Growth to drive go-to-market strategy for launches. You’ll trade learnings and best practices with peer teams, including Afterpay International.
 Some of this work is well established, with live journeys and a clear measurement history. Some of it has never had a dedicated owner. You’ll decide where to invest, build the opportunity case, and set the roadmap.
 What's Unique About This Role
 The AI frontier. You'll help define how engagement marketing evolves as decisioning and workflow automation take on more of the work, building on automation we already run today.
 Growth for Afterpay in the US, plus two core verticals. You’ll own the growth strategy for Afterpay in the US and oversee commerce and lending, deciding the right moment to introduce one product versus another to customers who use both Cash App and Afterpay.
 Room to define the work. Parts of the commerce and lending experience inside Cash App are open space. You'll size them, prioritize them, and decide what gets built.

title: People Project Manager
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft is changing fast. We’re integrating acquired businesses, growing in Europe and new global markets, launching new lines of business, and building a workforce for autonomous vehicles alongside our corporate teams. Half of our team members now live outside the US. Our People team has to keep pace, and that means designing programs that work for a bigger, more global and more varied Lyft.
 The People Strategy & Programs team leads complex, cross-functional work that comes to the People organization. We run the People team’s operating rhythms and make sure our biggest priorities get delivered across every People vertical: HR Operations, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Team Member Experience and People Business Partners.
 As People Project Manager, you’ll own high-complexity programs end to end as the People team transforms alongside the business. You’ll report to the Chief of Staff to the Chief People Officer and partner closely with People leaders, Finance, Legal and business leaders across Lyft. This isn’t a role where you hand work off once the plan is set. You’ll facilitate the strategy, validate it with subject matter experts, lead when the work needs a leader, and get into the details to keep it moving.
 This role is for a systems thinker who’s comfortable with ambiguity and enjoys every part of the People function. Success looks like complex programs that land well, People leaders who see you as a trusted partner, and repeatable approaches that make the next big project easier than the last.
 What you’ll work on:
 Your portfolio will shift with the business, but example programs include:
 Standing up People programs for new and growing workforces, such as hourly and field teams
 Partnering with the business on workforce and location strategy: the right roles in the right places at the rig…
